values: Use this checklist before launch. Update only the Status, Evidence / Link, and Notes columns. Never store API keys, passwords, card numbers, or private tokens here.
1. Complete account and domain tasks first.
2. Do all payment testing in Stripe test mode before going live.
3. Keep every customer link private and never record secrets here.
4. Mark each test Done only when you have evidence in the final column.
5. Switch to live mode only after every required line is Done.
Recommended MVP: custom secure quiz on your existing DigitalOcean Droplet + Stripe + Resend. Tally may be used for content drafting, but not as the protected access gate.

values: Complete in order. “You” means you need to create, verify, or approve the account/change. “Codex” means I can prepare or implement it once you authorise access.
One quiz per purchase; price, currency, and 7-day access rule are final.

Confirm GoDaddy domain ownership and login
Required to point a quiz subdomain to the website.
Provides free DNS, SSL support, and basic traffic protection.
Example: quiz.yourdomain.com. Keep it stable before launch.
Complete Stripe identity and bank verification
Stripe cannot pay out until required business details are verified.
Create one product and one price in Stripe
Keeps launch checkout simple; add more quizzes later.
Keep Stripe test and live modes separate
Prevents test payments or keys from reaching real customers.
The server, not the customer browser, confirms a successful payment.
Improves delivery and lets emails come from your domain.
Required for email authentication and lower spam risk.
Allows recovery if the Droplet or database is damaged.
Create isolated quiz service and database
Keeps customer access data separate from OpenClaw.
Makes quiz.yourdomain.com secure and publicly reachable.
Only web ports should be public; OpenClaw must stay isolated.
Store secrets in server environment variables
Never place private keys in source code or this sheet.
Explains the quiz, price, privacy, and purchase call to action.
Creates email-bound, expiring access after confirmed payment.
Build quiz questions and score logic
Shows one question per screen and calculates result server-side.
Shows the latest result and enables retake before expiry.
Deletes temporary quiz answers and results after access ends.

Keeps accounting data apart from sensitive self-reflection responses.
Set marketing consent to opt-in only
A purchase email is not automatic permission for marketing.
Lets you know if payment emails or access links fail.
Makes payment disputes and expired-link requests consistent.

values: Run every test in Stripe test mode first. Mark Done only after you record the result or evidence. Repeat the final “live payment” test with a real small payment before public launch.
One paid access record is created and one access email is sent.
No access link or active access record is created.
The same payment does not create a second paid access record.
Email arrives with correct sender, quiz name, and expiry time.
A new link works and the earlier unused link stops working.
Quiz opens after secure session is created.
Open forwarded link on another device
New device must verify the purchaser email; no email means no access.
After seven days, customer sees expiry message and cannot see quiz/result.
Score and result display immediately with disclaimer.
Customer can retake; newest temporary result replaces prior one.
Temporary answers/results are removed after expiry; payment record remains separate.
Invalid token and repeated code attempts
Invalid requests are blocked or rate-limited; no secrets exposed.
Landing, checkout, quiz, result, and retake work on a phone browser.
Flow works on current Chrome and Safari/Edge.
Database backup exists and recovery instructions are documented.
Live payment, email, access, retake, and refund/support workflow all work.
